{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Print number of QA orders
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = '999999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Filter to only completed orders
completed_only = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Print number of completed orders after QA removal
print(f"Number of completed orders after QA removal: {len(completed_only)}")

# Compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Print conversion rates
print("Conversion rates by segment:")
for segment, rate in conversion_by_segment.items():
    print(f"  {segment}: {rate:.6f}")

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
